name: Standing Kettlebell Finger Curl
poses: Standing full-body male, one arm hangs straight alongside thigh holding one kettlebell by its handle, palm inward, other hand on hip. Wrist stays neutral and elbow fully extended in all frames. Frame1 secure curled-finger grip; frame2 fingers partially extend so handle rolls lower toward fingertips without dropping bell; frame3 fingers curl handle back into palm. Feet torso shoulder elbow and wrist remain stationary, only fingers flex/extend. Same frontal three-quarter viewpoint. Fingers and kettlebell handle clearly separated and readable. Full body and entire kettlebell inside20% margins. No biceps curl, no wrist curl, no arm raise.
